entities.name: Dengue
entities.description: Acute mosquito-borne arboviral infection caused by the dengue virus, characterized by sudden high fever, retro-orbital pain, severe break-bone arthralgias/myalgias, and potential progression during defervescence to plasma leakage, thrombocytopenia, and hypovolemic shock.

entities.name: Aedes aegypti Mosquito Vector
entities.description: Primary diurnal anthropophilic mosquito vector that rests indoors, bites during daylight hours, and breeds in domestic artificial water containers in tropical and subtropical urban environments.

entities.name: Aedes albopictus Mosquito Vector
entities.description: Secondary mosquito vector of dengue adapted to peri-domestic and rural vegetated environments with higher cold tolerance.

entities.name: Rapid Unplanned Tropical Urbanization and Artificial Water Storage
entities.description: Dense urban tropical settings with inadequate piped water infrastructure requiring domestic water storage (cisterns, drums, clay jars) and discarded non-biodegradable containers (tires, plastic).

entities.name: Secondary Heterologous Dengue Infection
entities.description: Prior infection with a different dengue virus serotype predisposing the host to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), drastically elevating the risk of severe dengue and plasma leakage syndrome.

entities.name: Dengue Virus (DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, DENV-4)
entities.description: Enveloped, positive-sense single-stranded RNA arbovirus of the genus Flavivirus (family Flaviviridae) comprising four antigenically distinct serotypes.

entities.name: Retro-Orbital Headache Exacerbated by Eye Movements
entities.description: Severe frontal cephalalgia coupled with intense retrobulbar ache aggravated by ocular motion, highly characteristic of early dengue infection.

entities.name: Saddleback Biphasic Fever Pattern
entities.description: Abrupt high-grade fever (39-40°C) lasting 3 to 4 days that temporarily remits before recurring in a second spike around days 5 to 6.

entities.name: Positive Tourniquet Test with Petechial Capillary Fragility
entities.description: Bedside demonstration of >= 10 petechiae per square inch after maintaining blood pressure cuff midway between systolic and diastolic pressure for 5 minutes.

entities.name: Critical Phase Plasma Leakage with Narrowed Pulse Pressure
entities.description: Systemic vascular hyperpermeability occurring at or near defervescence (days 3-7) resulting in narrowing pulse pressure (<= 20 mmHg), cold clammy extremities, and dengue shock syndrome.

entities.name: Islands of White in a Sea of Red Convalescent Rash
entities.description: Confluent maculopapular petechial rash with sharply demarcated round pale islands of normal skin, accompanied by intense palmar and plantar pruritus during recovery (days 7-10).

entities.name: Early Leukopenia Nadir with Atypical Plasmacytoid Lymphocytosis
entities.description: Admission complete blood count revealing profound leukopenia (< 4,000/µL, often < 2,500/µL) driven by neutropenia, accompanied by reactive plasmacytoid lymphocytes prior to the critical phase.

entities.name: Severe Thrombocytopenia with Concurrent Hemoconcentration
entities.description: Rapid progressive platelet count decline (< 100,000/µL) concurrent with hematocrit elevation >= 20% above baseline (or HCT > 45% in adult males, > 40% in females), confirming vascular plasma leakage.

entities.name: Preferential AST Elevation over ALT Transaminitis
entities.description: Hepatic transaminitis displaying an AST:ALT ratio > 1 reflecting combined hepatocellular and skeletal muscle injury, accompanied by normal to minimally elevated total bilirubin.

entities.name: Gallbladder Wall Thickening with Pericholecystic Fluid and Right Pleural Effusion
entities.description: Point-of-care ultrasound demonstrating edematous, striated gallbladder wall thickening (>= 3 mm without gallstones), subcapsular hepatic fluid, and right-sided pleural effusion on chest imaging.

entities.name: Fever Duration Exceeding 10 Days
entities.description: Fever persisting continuously or intermittently beyond 10 days, exceeding the acute 2-7 day febrile envelope of dengue.

entities.name: Marked Neutrophilic Leukocytosis Exceeding 15,000/uL
entities.description: Peripheral white blood cell count exceeding 15,000/µL with neutrophilia and toxic left shift in the absence of secondary bacterial superinfection.

entities.name: Normal Platelet Count Above 150,000/uL on Days 4 to 7
entities.description: Complete preservation of normal platelet counts (> 150,000/µL) throughout days 4 through 7 of illness, making severe dengue and plasma leak syndrome exceedingly unlikely.

entities.name: Early Marked Direct Hyperbilirubinemia and Acute Renal Failure
entities.description: Early-onset deep clinical jaundice with direct hyperbilirubinemia and oliguric acute renal failure within the first 3 to 5 days of illness.

entities.name: Chikungunya
entities.description: Alphaviral infection transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes presenting with severe, symmetric polyarthritis/synovitis but lacking vascular hyperpermeability.

entities.name: Zika Virus Infection
entities.description: Arboviral flavivirus infection characterized by low-grade fever, bilateral non-purulent conjunctivitis, and early descending maculopapular rash without plasma leakage.

entities.name: Leptospirosis
entities.description: Zoonotic spirochetal infection causing fever, conjunctival suffusion, severe calf tenderness, marked neutrophilic leukocytosis, and hepato-renal failure (Weil disease).

entities.name: Malaria
entities.description: Intraerythrocytic parasitic infection caused by Plasmodium species presenting with periodic paroxysmal rigors, splenomegaly, and intravascular hemolytic anemia.

entities.name: Titrated Isotonic Crystalloid Fluid Resuscitation
entities.description: Judiciously administered isotonic crystalloids (normal saline, Ringer's lactate) restoring hemodynamic stability, normalizing pulse pressure, reducing hemoconcentration, and maintaining urine output (> 0.5-1 mL/kg/h).

entities.name: Empirical Broad-Spectrum Antibacterial Therapy
entities.description: Empirical broad-spectrum beta-lactams, macrolides, and fluoroquinolones that fail to alter fever defervescence, platelet trajectory, or hemoconcentration in acute dengue.

entities.name: NSAIDs and Aspirin Induced Bleeding Toxicity
entities.description: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory agents (ibuprofen, naproxen) and aspirin, which exacerbate hemorrhagic diathesis, provoke gastric ulceration, and impair platelet function.

entities.name: Paracetamol Antipyresis
entities.description: Acetaminophen (paracetamol) providing safe fever control and mild analgesic symptom relief without increasing the risk of mucosal or gastrointestinal hemorrhage.

relationships.keywords: TRANSMITTED_BY, primary vector, Aedes aegypti, diurnal mosquito, domestic breeder
relationships.description: [TRANSMITTED_BY] Transmitted primarily by the bites of infected female Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, which are highly anthropophilic, bite during daylight hours, and breed in domestic and peridomestic artificial water containers.

relationships.keywords: TRANSMITTED_BY, secondary vector, Aedes albopictus, peri-domestic vector
relationships.description: [TRANSMITTED_BY] Transmitted secondarily by Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, which thrive in peri-domestic vegetated habitats and tolerate cooler climates, expanding transmission into suburban and rural regions.

relationships.target: Rapid Unplanned Tropical Urbanization and Artificial Water Storage
relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, urban transmission, domestic water storage, artificial larval containers
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Driven by rapid unplanned urbanization with high population density, intermittent municipal water forcing domestic water storage in cisterns/drums/jars, and accumulation of discarded tires and plastic containers.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, antibody dependent enhancement, heterologous serotype, severe dengue risk
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Previous infection with a heterologous DENV serotype predisposes the patient to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), leading to massive viral replication, intense cytokine release, and high risk of severe plasma leakage.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGEN, causative agent, Flavivirus, arbovirus, positive-sense RNA
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGEN] Caused by the dengue virus (DENV), a positive-sense single-stranded RNA Flavivirus existing as four distinct antigenic serotypes (DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, and DENV-4).

relationships.target: Retro-Orbital Headache Exacerbated by Eye Movements
relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, retro-orbital pain, ocular movement headache, early febrile sign
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Severe frontal headache paired with intense retro-orbital pain exacerbated by eye movements during the early febrile phase is a cardinal clinical hallmark of dengue fever.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, saddleback fever, biphasic temperature curve, clinical timeline
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Abrupt onset high-grade fever (39-40°C) with a saddleback biphasic profile—temporary defervescence around day 3-4 followed by a secondary febrile spike—is highly suggestive of dengue.

relationships.target: Positive Tourniquet Test with Petechial Capillary Fragility
relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, tourniquet test, petechiae, capillary fragility, triage hallmark
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Detection of >= 10 petechiae per square inch under 5-minute mid-blood pressure cuff inflation provides an immediate, low-cost bedside physical hallmark of vascular capillary fragility in dengue.

relationships.target: Critical Phase Plasma Leakage with Narrowed Pulse Pressure
relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, plasma leakage, critical phase, narrowing pulse pressure, dengue shock
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Acute systemic capillary hyperpermeability developing at defervescence (days 3-7), manifesting as narrowing pulse pressure (<= 20 mmHg), cold clammy extremities, and fluid accumulation, defines the critical phase of severe dengue.

relationships.target: Islands of White in a Sea of Red Convalescent Rash
relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, convalescent rash, islands of white, pruritic rash, pathognomonic sign
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Confluent erythematous maculopapular petechial eruption sparing small rounded areas of pale normal skin ('islands of white in a sea of red'), accompanied by intense palmar and plantar itching, is pathognomonic during recovery (days 7-10).

relationships.target: Early Leukopenia Nadir with Atypical Plasmacytoid Lymphocytosis
relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, leukopenia, neutropenia, atypical lymphocytes, admission CBC
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Early admission leukopenia (WBC nadir < 4,000/µL, frequently < 2,500/µL) driven by neutropenia and early lymphopenia, followed by the appearance of reactive plasmacytoid lymphocytes, heralds the critical phase.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, thrombocytopenia, hemoconcentration, hematocrit rise, plasma leakage
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Rapidly declining platelet count (< 100,000/µL, dropping < 20,000/µL in severe cases) combined with a >= 20% elevation in hematocrit above baseline serves as the definitive laboratory pattern of vascular plasma extravasation.

relationships.target: Preferential AST Elevation over ALT Transaminitis
relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, AST higher than ALT, hepatic transaminitis, normal bilirubin, triage LFTs
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum aminotransferases show elevated AST and ALT with AST characteristically higher than ALT (AST:ALT ratio > 1) due to virus-mediated skeletal muscle and hepatocyte necrosis, alongside normal total bilirubin.

relationships.target: Gallbladder Wall Thickening with Pericholecystic Fluid and Right Pleural Effusion
relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, POCUS ultrasound, gallbladder wall edema, right pleural effusion, bedside imaging
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Point-of-care ultrasound demonstrating thickened striated gallbladder wall (>= 3 mm without lithiasis), subcapsular hepatic fluid, and right-sided pleural effusion on chest imaging serves as an early triage imaging marker of capillary leak.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, fever duration cutoff
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] A febrile illness lasting continuously or intermittently longer than 10 days rules out acute dengue, which strictly adheres to a 2 to 7 day (maximum 10 day) febrile timeframe.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, leukocytosis cutoff
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Marked neutrophilic leukocytosis (WBC > 15,000/µL) with toxic bandemia in the absence of secondary bacterial superinfection rules out uncomplicated dengue, which is consistently characterized by leukopenia.

relationships.target: Normal Platelet Count Above 150,000/uL on Days 4 to 7
relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, normal platelets, critical window
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] A normal platelet count (> 150,000/µL) maintained during days 4 through 7 of illness makes severe dengue and dengue hemorrhagic fever virtually impossible.

relationships.target: Early Marked Direct Hyperbilirubinemia and Acute Renal Failure
relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, early jaundice, acute renal failure
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Early gross clinical jaundice with direct hyperbilirubinemia and oliguric acute renal failure at initial admission rules out uncomplicated dengue, strongly indicating leptospirosis (Weil disease) or severe malaria.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, symmetric polyarthritis, joint disability
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Chikungunya causes excruciating, symmetric polyarthritis and tenosynovitis (wrists, fingers, ankles) with preserved platelet counts (> 100,000/µL) and absence of capillary leak; Dengue causes dominant retro-orbital pain, severe neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and plasma leak.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, non-purulent conjunctivitis, low-grade fever
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Zika virus infection is characterized by low-grade fever (< 38.5°C), prominent bilateral non-purulent conjunctivitis, and early descending pruritic maculopapular rash without plasma leakage; Dengue causes high fever (> 39°C), severe thrombocytopenia (< 50,000/µL), and hemoconcentration.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, conjunctival suffusion, calf myalgia, Weil disease
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leptospirosis presents with marked bilateral conjunctival suffusion, intense calf pain, neutrophilic leukocytosis (WBC > 12,000/µL), high ESR/CRP, and early direct hyperbilirubinemia with azotemia; Dengue exhibits leukopenia, AST > ALT, normal bilirubin, and hemoconcentration.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, cyclical rigors, splenomegaly, hemolytic anemia
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Malaria exhibits periodic paroxysms of severe rigors, prominent early splenomegaly, and hemolytic anemia (elevated indirect bilirubin, high LDH) without hemoconcentration or plasma extravasation; Dengue exhibits retro-orbital pain, hemoconcentration, and vascular leak syndrome.

relationships.keywords: RESPONDS_TO, fluid resuscitation, isotonic crystalloids, pulse pressure stabilization
relationships.description: [RESPONDS_TO] Meticulously titrated intravenous isotonic crystalloids (normal saline or Ringer's lactate) achieve prompt widening of narrowed pulse pressure, reduction of elevated hematocrit, and maintenance of urine output (> 0.5-1 mL/kg/h) during dengue shock.

relationships.keywords: INTRINSICALLY_RESISTANT_TO, antibiotic refractoriness, therapeutic unresponsiveness, viral etiology
relationships.description: [INTRINSICALLY_RESISTANT_TO] Empirical broad-spectrum beta-lactams, macrolides, or fluoroquinolones completely fail to produce defervescence or alter the platelet and hematocrit trajectories in acute dengue.

relationships.target: NSAIDs and Aspirin Induced Bleeding Toxicity
relationships.keywords: INTRINSICALLY_RESISTANT_TO, contraindication, hemorrhagic risk, gastritis, platelet inhibition
relationships.description: [INTRINSICALLY_RESISTANT_TO] Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and aspirin are strictly contraindicated due to their provocation of severe mucosal hemorrhage, gastrointestinal ulceration, and exacerbation of platelet dysfunction.

relationships.keywords: RESPONDS_TO, safe antipyresis, symptomatic pain relief, paracetamol, acetaminophen
relationships.description: [RESPONDS_TO] Paracetamol (acetaminophen) provides safe antipyresis and relief of break-bone musculoskeletal aches at weight-appropriate dosages without compromising hemostasis or precipitating hemorrhage.
